title: Noto theme
description: A Noto colour theme (.nototheme), format version 1. ADR-023 is the contract: it lists the same properties, says which ADR-011 tokens each one sets, and gives the alpha and contrast rules Noto checks. Properties this schema does not name are ignored by Noto with a warning, so a file written for a newer Noto still loads.

$schema.description: Where an editor finds this schema. Noto never fetches it.

version.description: The format version. Noto refuses a version newer than the one it reads.

name.description: The theme's name in Settings. Unique among installed themes, ignoring case; "Default" is Noto's own.

author.description: Who made the theme. Shown in Settings.

light.description: Colours used when Noto is light. Overrides "any", property by property.

dark.description: Colours used when Noto is dark. Overrides "any", property by property.

any.description: Colours used in both light and dark, unless the light or dark section sets the same property.

colour.description: #rgb, #rrggbb or #rrggbbaa (CSS order: alpha last). Hex digits in either case.

note.description: One of the six note colours. Each part is optional; a part not set keeps Noto's own.

tint.description: Laid over a coloured note's card. Alpha is kept: a tint is meant to be translucent.

marker.description: The note's colour mark, and its only colour in the Bar style. Opaque.

name.description: What the colour is called in menus and read by a screen reader.

background.description: The drawer, the folder list and every surface's header. Opaque.

card.description: A note's card, the editor and text inputs. Opaque.

code.description: Behind inline code and code blocks. Alpha is flattened over the card.

textSecondary.description: Secondary text and Markdown markers. Opaque.

textDisabled.description: Text of a command that is not available. Opaque.

checkmark.description: A task's checkbox, ticked or not. Opaque.

danger.description: A warning or a failure in the notice line. Opaque.

accent.description: Selection: the selected row's pill and the edited card's edge. Opaque. Not set, it is the Windows accent.

border.description: Card and input edges. Alpha is kept.

highlight.description: Behind ::highlighted:: text. Alpha is flattened over the card.
